ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue and operating EBITDA growth of 13% and 28% respectively, driven by strategic expansion into mobile phone manufacturing and localized HDI PCB production. However, profitability was significantly impacted by an undisclosed INR 123 crore exceptional loss, along with margin compression in the bare PCB and railway divisions due to commodity inflation, currency depreciation, and pricing lags. These operational headwinds are expected to persist through H1 FY27, warranting close monitoring.
